title: Yaa Asantewaa
summary: Yaa Asantewaa was the ohemaa (queen mother) of Ejisu in the Asante Empire. After Governor Frederick Hodgson demanded the Golden Stool in March 1900, she became symbolic and strategic leader of the resistance and helped organise the siege of the British fort at Kumasi. Britain broke the siege, and she was exiled to the Seychelles, where she died in 1921.

uncertainty.note: Birth is "c. 1840" on one page and no other page gives a birth date; the plus/minus is a placeholder for "c." Death is 17 October 1921.
